en.greeting: Hi! Today you'll tell stories in the past: what was happening, and what happened. Let's go step by step.

steps.title: Background and main event
steps.text: You know was/were + -ing for something in progress at a past time. Now let's use it in a story.
steps.body: In a story, **was/were + -ing** is the **background** (*latar*): the longer action that was already happening. The **past simple** is the **main event** (*kejadian utama*): the short thing that happened in the middle of it. **I was cooking when the phone rang.** Indonesian changes neither verb (*Saya sedang memasak ketika telepon berbunyi*), so ask: which action was **long**, which was **short**? Only the long one takes -ing.

pairs.en: I was cooking when the phone rang.
pairs.id: Saya sedang memasak ketika telepon berbunyi.

steps.title: A long bar and a short point
steps.text: Picture the evening. Where does the phone call happen?

timeline.title: I was cooking when the phone rang.
timeline.caption: The cooking is the long bar (7:00–7:45): was cooking. The call is a short point in the middle of it (7:20): rang. Long action → was/were + -ing; short event → past simple.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.text: Lunch with friends. Which action is the short one?

question.prompt: Complete: We were having lunch at the warung when it suddenly ___ to rain.
question.explanation: Having lunch is the long background action (were having). The rain starting is the short event in the middle of it → past simple: **started**. 'was starting' puts the short event in the continuous, and 'starts' is present.

steps.title: when or while?
steps.text: Indonesian says saat or ketika for both. English chooses by how long the action is.
steps.body: **when + past simple** → the **short** event: *… when the phone rang.* **while + was/were + -ing** → the **long** action: *While I was walking home, I saw Rina.* After while keep **was** and **-ing**: 'While I was walk' ✗. Never while + a short event: 'while the phone rang' ✗. Comma only when the when/while part comes first. (*When I was cooking, …* is also correct, but **while** is clearer for the long action.) **during** goes before a noun: *during the meeting*.

pairs.en: While I was walking home, I saw Rina.
pairs.id: Saat saya sedang berjalan pulang, saya melihat Rina.

pairs.en: We were having dinner when the lights went out.
pairs.id: Kami sedang makan malam ketika lampu mati.

pairs.en: Sari fell asleep while she was watching the film.
pairs.id: Sari tertidur saat sedang menonton film.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.text: A busy morning at the office.

question.prompt: Complete: I was making coffee in the office kitchen ___ the fire alarm went off.
question.explanation: 'the fire alarm went off' is a short event in the past simple → **when**. **while** needs a long action with was/were + -ing, and **during** goes before a noun (*during the meeting*), not a sentence.

steps.title: Build the sentence
steps.text: Now put while first, with the long action.

question.solution: While I was waiting, my phone rang.
question.prompt: Arrange the words. Start with While: Saat saya sedang menunggu, HP saya berbunyi.
question.explanation: **While + was/were + -ing** for the long action (*I was waiting*), then the short event in the past simple (*my phone rang*). The while part comes first, so a comma follows it: **While I was waiting, my phone rang.**

steps.title: Same time, or one after another?
steps.text: Two more patterns, and then a whole story.
steps.body: Two long actions **at the same time** → **while** + was/were + -ing in **both** parts. One event **after another** → past simple in both (*When the film ended, we went home* = first the film ended, then we went home). A story often starts with the **scene** (was/were + -ing), then tells the **events** (past simple), often with **suddenly** (*tiba-tiba*).

examples.en: While I was studying, my brother was playing games.
examples.id: Saat saya sedang belajar, saudara laki-lakiku sedang bermain game. (bersamaan)

examples.en: While the teacher was talking, the students were taking notes.
examples.id: Saat guru sedang berbicara, para murid sedang mencatat. (bersamaan)

examples.en: When the film ended, we went home.
It was a rainy morning, and everyone was waiting for the KRL.
examples.id: Pagi itu hujan, dan semua orang sedang menunggu KRL. (latar)

examples.en: Suddenly the train stopped, and the lights went out.
examples.id: Tiba-tiba keretanya berhenti, dan lampunya mati. (kejadian)

steps.title: Your turn
steps.text: Saturday morning: everyone at home was busy.

options: While Sari was clean the kitchen, Dimas was washing the car.
While Sari cleaning the kitchen, Dimas was washing the car.
While Sari was cleaning the kitchen, Dimas was washing the car.
question.prompt: Sari and Dimas were busy at the same time. Choose the correct sentence.
question.explanation: Two long actions at the same time → **while** + was/were + -ing in both parts: **was cleaning … was washing**. 'was clean' drops the -ing, and 'Sari cleaning' drops was.

steps.title: Listen to the story
steps.text: Rina tells you about last night. Press play and listen.

question.listen: Last night I was studying in my room, and my sister was watching TV. Suddenly our cat jumped onto my desk.
options: Rina was studying in her room.
The cat jumped onto Rina's desk.
question.prompt: Listen to Rina's short story. What was the main event (the thing that happened)?
question.explanation: Rina sets the scene with **was studying** and **was watching** (both background, at the same time). The main event is the short action in the past simple, after **suddenly**: **our cat jumped onto my desk**.

steps.title: Quick review
steps.text: Flip through these cards: long or short, when or while.

flashcards.back: was/were + -ing: I was cooking. (saya sedang memasak)
past simple: The phone rang. (telepon berbunyi)
the short event, past simple: … when the phone rang. (ketika telepon berbunyi)
the long action, was/were + -ing: while I was walking home (saat saya sedang berjalan pulang)

flashcards.front: Two long actions at the same time
flashcards.back: while + was/were + -ing in both: While I was studying, my brother was playing games.

flashcards.front: I was watching TV when the phone was ringing. ✗
flashcards.back: I was watching TV when the phone rang. ✓

flashcards.front: While I was walk home, I saw Rina. ✗
flashcards.back: While I was walking home, I saw Rina. ✓
Yesterday at 8 I was watching TV. ✓ (Kemarin jam 8 saya sedang menonton TV.)

steps.title: Cheat sheet
steps.text: Here's everything on one page. Keep it for later.

artifact.title: Cheat sheet · past simple & past continuous
artifact.intro: Long action in progress → was/were + -ing. Short event → past simple.
rows: background: a long action in progress
a short event in the middle of a long action
I was cooking when the phone rang.
While I was walking home, I saw Rina.
two actions at the same time
While I was studying, my brother was playing games.
When the film ended, we went home.
tips: The short event stays in the past simple: 'when the phone was ringing' ✗ → **when the phone rang**.
After **while**: was/were + -ing. 'While I was walk' ✗ → **While I was walking**. **during** + a noun: *during the meeting*.
A story: the scene in was/were + -ing, then the events in the past simple (**suddenly**, **then**, **after that**).

examples.en: Budi was driving to the office when his car broke down.
examples.id: Budi sedang menyetir ke kantor ketika mobilnya mogok.

examples.en: While Pak Hasan was giving his presentation, his phone rang.
examples.id: Saat Pak Hasan sedang presentasi, HP-nya berbunyi.

examples.en: When I got to the station, my friends were waiting for me.
examples.id: Ketika saya sampai di stasiun, teman-temanku sedang menungguku.

examples.en: It was a rainy morning, and everyone was waiting for the KRL. Suddenly the train stopped.
examples.id: Pagi itu hujan, dan semua orang sedang menunggu KRL. Tiba-tiba keretanya berhenti.

id.greeting: Hai! Hari ini kamu akan bercerita tentang masa lalu: apa yang sedang terjadi, dan apa yang terjadi. Ayo kita pelajari pelan-pelan.

steps.title: Latar dan kejadian utama
steps.text: Kamu sudah tahu was/were + -ing untuk kegiatan yang sedang berlangsung di masa lalu. Sekarang kita pakai dalam cerita.
steps.body: Dalam cerita, **was/were + -ing** adalah **latar**: kegiatan yang lebih panjang dan sudah sedang terjadi. **Past simple** adalah **kejadian utama**: hal singkat yang terjadi di tengah-tengahnya. **I was cooking when the phone rang.** Bahasa Indonesia tidak mengubah kedua kata kerjanya (*Saya sedang memasak ketika telepon berbunyi*), jadi tanyakan: kegiatan mana yang **panjang**, mana yang **singkat**? Hanya yang panjang yang memakai -ing.

pairs.en: I was cooking when the phone rang.
pairs.id: Saya sedang memasak ketika telepon berbunyi.

steps.title: Garis panjang dan titik pendek
steps.text: Bayangkan malam itu. Telepon itu terjadi di mana?

timeline.title: I was cooking when the phone rang.
timeline.caption: Memasak adalah garis panjang (7.00–7.45): was cooking. Telepon adalah titik pendek di tengahnya (7.20): rang. Kegiatan panjang → was/were + -ing; kejadian singkat → past simple.

steps.title: Giliranmu
steps.text: Makan siang bersama teman. Kegiatan mana yang singkat?

question.prompt: Lengkapi: We were having lunch at the warung when it suddenly ___ to rain.
question.explanation: Makan siang adalah kegiatan latar yang panjang (were having). Hujan mulai turun adalah kejadian singkat di tengahnya → past simple: **started**. 'was starting' membuat kejadian singkat memakai bentuk continuous, dan 'starts' itu bentuk sekarang.

steps.title: when atau while?
steps.text: Bahasa Indonesia bilang saat atau ketika untuk keduanya. Bahasa Inggris memilih berdasarkan panjang kegiatannya.
steps.body: **when + past simple** → kejadian **singkat**: *… when the phone rang.* **while + was/were + -ing** → kegiatan **panjang**: *While I was walking home, I saw Rina.* Setelah while tetap pakai **was** dan **-ing**: 'While I was walk' ✗. Jangan while + kejadian singkat: 'while the phone rang' ✗. Koma hanya kalau bagian when/while ada di depan. (*When I was cooking, …* juga benar, tapi **while** lebih jelas untuk kegiatan panjang.) **during** dipakai sebelum kata benda: *during the meeting* (selama rapat).

pairs.en: While I was walking home, I saw Rina.
pairs.id: Saat saya sedang berjalan pulang, saya melihat Rina.

pairs.en: We were having dinner when the lights went out.
pairs.id: Kami sedang makan malam ketika lampu mati.

pairs.en: Sari fell asleep while she was watching the film.
pairs.id: Sari tertidur saat sedang menonton film.

steps.title: Giliranmu
steps.text: Pagi yang sibuk di kantor.

question.prompt: Lengkapi: I was making coffee in the office kitchen ___ the fire alarm went off.
question.explanation: 'the fire alarm went off' (alarm kebakaran berbunyi) adalah kejadian singkat dalam past simple → **when**. **while** butuh kegiatan panjang dengan was/were + -ing, dan **during** dipakai sebelum kata benda (*during the meeting*), bukan sebelum kalimat.

steps.title: Susun kalimatnya
steps.text: Sekarang taruh while di depan, dengan kegiatan panjangnya.

question.solution: While I was waiting, my phone rang.
question.prompt: Susun kata-katanya. Mulai dengan While: Saat saya sedang menunggu, HP saya berbunyi.
question.explanation: **While + was/were + -ing** untuk kegiatan panjang (*I was waiting*), lalu kejadian singkat dalam past simple (*my phone rang*). Bagian while ada di depan, jadi diikuti koma: **While I was waiting, my phone rang.**

steps.title: Bersamaan, atau berurutan?
steps.text: Dua pola lagi, lalu sebuah cerita utuh.
steps.body: Dua kegiatan panjang **bersamaan** → **while** + was/were + -ing di **kedua** bagian. Satu kejadian **setelah** yang lain → past simple di keduanya (*When the film ended, we went home* = filmnya selesai dulu, lalu kami pulang). Cerita sering dimulai dengan **latar** (was/were + -ing), lalu menceritakan **kejadiannya** (past simple), sering dengan **suddenly** (tiba-tiba).

examples.en: While I was studying, my brother was playing games.
examples.id: Saat saya sedang belajar, saudara laki-lakiku sedang bermain game. (bersamaan)

examples.en: While the teacher was talking, the students were taking notes.
examples.id: Saat guru sedang berbicara, para murid sedang mencatat. (bersamaan)

examples.en: When the film ended, we went home.
It was a rainy morning, and everyone was waiting for the KRL.
examples.id: Pagi itu hujan, dan semua orang sedang menunggu KRL. (latar)

examples.en: Suddenly the train stopped, and the lights went out.
examples.id: Tiba-tiba keretanya berhenti, dan lampunya mati. (kejadian)

steps.title: Giliranmu
steps.text: Sabtu pagi: semua orang di rumah sibuk.

options: While Sari was clean the kitchen, Dimas was washing the car.
While Sari cleaning the kitchen, Dimas was washing the car.
While Sari was cleaning the kitchen, Dimas was washing the car.
question.prompt: Sari dan Dimas sibuk pada waktu yang sama. Pilih kalimat yang benar.
question.explanation: Dua kegiatan panjang bersamaan → **while** + was/were + -ing di kedua bagian: **was cleaning … was washing**. 'was clean' kehilangan -ing, dan 'Sari cleaning' kehilangan was.

steps.title: Dengarkan ceritanya
steps.text: Rina bercerita tentang tadi malam. Tekan play dan dengarkan.

question.listen: Last night I was studying in my room, and my sister was watching TV. Suddenly our cat jumped onto my desk.
options: Rina was studying in her room.
The cat jumped onto Rina's desk.
question.prompt: Dengarkan cerita singkat Rina. Apa kejadian utamanya (hal yang terjadi)?
question.explanation: Rina membangun latar dengan **was studying** dan **was watching** (keduanya latar, bersamaan). Kejadian utamanya adalah kegiatan singkat dalam past simple, setelah **suddenly**: **our cat jumped onto my desk**.

steps.title: Ulasan cepat
steps.text: Balik kartu-kartu ini: panjang atau singkat, when atau while.

steps.title: Ringkasan
steps.text: Ini semuanya dalam satu halaman. Simpan untuk nanti.

artifact.title: Ringkasan · past simple & past continuous
artifact.intro: Kegiatan panjang yang sedang berlangsung → was/were + -ing. Kejadian singkat → past simple.
rows: latar: kegiatan panjang yang sedang berlangsung
kejadian singkat di tengah kegiatan panjang
I was cooking when the phone rang.
While I was walking home, I saw Rina.
While I was studying, my brother was playing games.
When the film ended, we went home.
tips: Kejadian singkat tetap past simple: 'when the phone was ringing' ✗ → **when the phone rang**.
Setelah **while**: was/were + -ing. 'While I was walk' ✗ → **While I was walking**. **during** + kata benda: *during the meeting*.
Cerita: latar dengan was/were + -ing, lalu kejadian dengan past simple (**suddenly**, **then**, **after that**).
